messages:
maya: Reminder: v2 header rollout scheduled for 08:45 UTC in the quiet window. This is the header-signal only change (no model swap). Keep an eye on client compatibility pins and metric drift.

deploybot: Scheduled job: 
- action: header-rollout
- header: X-API-Version: v2
- rollout-id: rb-6278904321
- steps: 1) 1% 2) 10% 3) 100%
- start: 08:45 UTC

thao: Quick check  are there any pinned tenants in the pinlist? I don't want to surprise support.

maya: Pinlist: tenant-pins.csv updated; 3 tenants pinned for v1 (legacy-payments, gov-east, partner-x). Link: https://internal/release/pinlists/v2.

ops-runner: Oncall standing by. Rollback thresholds: global 5xx > 1% for 5m OR client 4xx jump >2x baseline for 10m -> operator hold. Also watch header mismatch telemetry (clients rejecting unknown responses).

sam: Release notes draft updated: "v2 header introduces optional routing info; backward compatible. Clients using strict header validation older than 1.4 may see 4xx." Please review.

--- (rollout start) ---

deploybot: Step 1 started: 1% traffic to v2 header at 08:46 UTC (rb-6278904321-step1).

ops-runner: Noted small uptick in 4xx from tenant partner-y around 08:47. Investigating.

thao: Which errors?

ops-runner: 400s with body: "unknown_header_version" coming from proxy logs for partner-y. Appears the client's gateway treats header as unsupported string and rejects.

maya: Partner-y is not in pinlist. Might be a downstream gateway mis-configured. Contacting partner ops lead.

sam: Recommend pausing progression and adding partner-y to a hold override until they patch. We should not flip global if any external partner infra is strict.

deploybot: Operator action: paused progression at step1 by ops-runner at 08:50 UTC. rb-6278904321 paused.

ops-runner: Applied runtime override: exclude tenant partner-y from header rollout and added runtime `header_compat_mode=permissive` for their edge cluster. Monitoring.

ops-runner: Error rate for partner-y dropped to baseline within 45s. No other tenants affected.

maya: Given the fix, propose to resume and proceed to 10% but keep an exclusion list for known strict gateways (legacy partners). Update release notes + ops checklist.

sam: Added note in release notes: "Known strict proxies: partner-y, gov-east. These will remain pinned to v1 until validated." Also added contact steps for partner outreach.

release-coach: Small follow-ups: 1) add a pre-rollout check to verify no partner edge clusters have `strict_header_handling` enabled 2) capture partner-y contact who needs the SDK patch timeline.

maya: Resuming rollout at 09:02 UTC. Step 2 -> 10% now.

deploybot: Step 2 started: 10% rollout rb-6278904321-step2.

ops-runner: Monitoring P95 latency and 4xx/5xx. No new anomalies after 10m. Proceed to 100% at 09:15 UTC if stable.

maya: Thanks everyone. Postmortem item: detect mis-configured partner edges earlier, add preflight checklist item. Will circulate final release notes once 100% complete.

deploybot: Rollout completed to 100% at 09:16 UTC. rb-6278904321 completed. Logs and artifacts at https://internal/release/logs/rb-6278904321.
